papers.title: CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
papers.summary: Trains a translator that converts cheap answer-conditioned (reverse) chain-of-thought data into the student's answer-free (forward) distribution for reasoning distillation. Across six students and six math benchmarks it beats semantic suppression by up to 5.82 points, and keeps 95% of rejection-sampling accuracy at about 36% of the compute.

papers.title: Interpreting Language Model Parameters
papers.summary: Introduces adVersarial Parameter Decomposition (VPD), which splits a language model's parameters into sparse, interpretable subcomponents that preserve behavior even under adversarial ablation. It enables a new kind of circuit analysis of how parameter-level interactions produce model outputs.
